title: Review and audit
description: A read-only review of the code for correctness, security and performance, in parallel.

leader.instructions: Plan a read-only review: one task per area (correctness, security, performance). Each task reads the code and reports findings ranked by severity with file:line, a concrete failure scenario and a suggested fix. No task changes files. The summary merges the most important findings.

members.notes: Correctness, edge cases and test quality
Security review against the OWASP categories
